name: Tool and MCP pruning, propose-only (TokenEconomizer idea TE-T1)
summary: An analysis that proposes removing tool and MCP definitions that sessions never use. Propose-only; a deny list it led to would be personal, at user or local scope with consent per rule (ADR-0010). Native MCP tool search covers most of this job, and the kill test checks the rest. Analysis only; no session cost.

evidence.setting: Design idea; v8's version is unbuilt and unmeasured
evidence.effect: Unused tool definitions go out with every request; pruning them could save input tokens (expected, not measured)

killTest.hypothesis: Pruning unused tool definitions saves tokens
killTest.pass: Prunable definitions are at least 2% of median input and the gain is at least 5% over at least 10 tasks x 2 runs, with no restore needed within 2 weeks

maintenance: Owned engine feature, maintained with the engine.
